Under a differential-price auction, for example, if the highest accepted yield is 3.055%, bid yields are grouped into ranges such as 3.055-3.020%, 3.015-2.980%, and 2.975-2.940%. The accepted yield applied to each group is the highest yield within the respective group-namely, 3.055%, 3.015%, and 2.975%.
